"import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions (mm)
# Horizontal Leg: x[0, 80], y[0, 40], z[0, 10]
L_H = 80.0
W = 40.0
THICKNESS = 10.0

# Vertical Leg: x[0, 10], y[0, 40], z[0, 60]
L_V = 10.0
H_V = 60.0

# Fillet
R_FILLET = 12.0

# Holes
D_HOLE = 9.0
R_HOLE = D_HOLE / 2.0

# 1. Create Horizontal Leg
# Center of box should be at (40, 20, 5) to span x[0,80], y[0,40], z[0,10]
leg_h = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L_H, W, THICKNESS).translate((L_H/2, W/2, THICKNESS/2))

# 2. Create Vertical Leg
# Center of box should be at (5, 20, 30) to span x[0,10], y[0,40], z[0,60]
leg_v = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L_V, W, H_V).translate((L_V/2, W/2, H_V/2))

# 3. Union to form L-bracket
part = leg_h.union(leg_v)

# 4. Add Inner Concave Fillet
# The inner edge is at the intersection of x=10 and z=10 (along y).
# Midpoint of this edge is (10, 20, 10).
# The fillet radius is 12.
inner_edge = part.edges(cq.NearToPointSelector((10, 20, 10)))
part = part.fillet(R_FILLET, inner_edge)

# 5. Add Horizontal Leg Hole
# Axis parallel to Z, centered at (x=45, y=20).
# Located on the top face of the horizontal leg (z=10).
# Point (45, 20, 10) lies on this face.
h1_face = part.faces(cq.NearToPointSelector((45, 20, 10)))
part = h1_face.workplane().hole(D_HOLE)

# 6. Add Vertical Leg Hole
# Axis parallel to X, centered at (y=20, z=35).
# Located on the inner face of the vertical leg (x=10).
# Point (10, 20, 35) lies on this face.
# Note: z=35 is above the fillet extent (z=34), so it is on the planar face.
h2_face = part.faces(cq.NearToPointSelector((10, 20, 35)))
part = h2_face.workplane().hole(D_HOLE)

# 7. Export to STEP
cq.exporters.export(part, "part.step")"
